notes.rubric: C1 holds and C2 holds: the ceiling sentence corresponds to the source's and its numbers are the source's. The 0.8.2 and 0.14.4 panels on this case returned STANDS, which needs every criterion to hold, so they graded C3 and C4 as holding; the adjudication block records the earlier panel on the real passage, which failed both. The 0.8.2 record gives its C3 reading: the stamped record covers the two numbers it claims, not the sentences lifted beside them.

notes.owner_decision: Recorded as a hard negative, from a rubric v4 panel that cleared the real repository passage, until the 0.8.2 and 0.14.4 (copy rubric v5) panels on this case each returned a unanimous near-verbatim finding on line 12. Converted under the owner's rule of 2026-10-26 that a unanimous blind label is accepted, recorded at https://github.com/melodic-software/claude-code-plugins/issues/5654#issuecomment-6417188551.
notes.carries: This case fails a run that clears a lifted sentence because a record elsewhere in the file names the sentence's numbers. A record covers what it names.
